context: VideoPlayer updates the document title with the video's duration once its metadata has loaded.
explanation: duration was moved from state into a ref, and the second effect lists durationRef.current in its dependency array. React compares the ref object's identity across renders, not the value inside .current, and mutating a ref never triggers a re-render in the first place — so the title-updating effect never runs again after the initial render. Fix: keep duration in state so updates both trigger a re-render and are visible in the dependency array.
